[[Banishing|Banishing 117]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Banishing|Banishing 117]]:''' On Hit: 7d6 [[Bane]] damage to [[Extraplanar|Outsiders]].
On [[Vorpal Strike|Vorpal Hit]]: If an outsider struck by this weapon has fewer than 3320 Hit Points, it is instantly slain. If the outsider has above 3320 Hit Points, it takes 7d20 damage.
